2. Click the template link in the PDF and open it with a free Canva account.
3. Edit any question or leave it as it is. You can also change fonts and colors, and move or delete any element.
4. Download as PDF Print and print a set of rounds for each team. The host keeps the Answer Key and the Score Sheet.

GOOD TO KNOW
